_comment: What a painted tree is made of (scripts/rooms/foliage.gd, docs/BACKDROP_LIFE.md «Деревья»). A sway zone in data/backdrops.json becomes a tree with "tree": <style>: its crown hangs on a spring (stiff: how many swings a second, damp: how soon it settles, bend: the most pixels it leans) that a blow, a body passing through, a gust or a landing sets swinging, and it sheds what it is made of. colors: the leaves' shades (the room's Ambient tints them like the painting); shape leaf (a tumbling 2x1 pixel) | strand (a hanging 1xN thread of moss) | twig (a stick that bounces once); twigs: the share that are twigs; drift: leaves a second per 100 px of crown on a still night; shed: how many a gust or a body tears loose; burst: leaves a blow throws; fall: the speed a leaf settles at in still air; flutter: how wide it swings as it falls; rest: seconds a leaf lies before it fades. birds: the ravens a sway zone's "birds" (1-4) seats on its branch tops — body, rim (the sky on their backs) and beak colours; scare: how near a fast body (or a third of that, any body) sends them off, px; flock: how near one leaving takes the others with it, px; away: seconds before they come back; speed: how fast they fly off, px/s.
